info.title: carbium account API
info.description: Manage a carbium account by API with an account API key (c_acct_...): service keys and their policies, webhooks, usage and telemetry. A key cannot buy, upgrade or cancel anything. Docs: /docs#account-api-keys

accountApiKey.description: Authorization: Bearer c_acct_... (made on the Account page; shown once)

get.summary: your service keys, oldest first, revoked ones included: key_id, prefix, name, tier, scope, status, per_method_caps, max_connections, max_inflight, ip_allow, created_at, rotated_at, revoked_at (allow_domains and allow_ips are old lists the doors do not use). Never a key's value
